name: Early Shift
source:
You moved down south here two months ago. Between lectures, the long-ass drive to school, and the sweat-soaked summer, you don't expect much to change... That is, until you meet Cooper, an alligator (?) who works at the local Shell. 

What starts as a simple stop for fuel could turn into something more...

Early Shift is a furry visual novel set in a small-town in Florida.

[From [url=https://noisybear.itch.io/early-shift]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个月前你搬到南方来了。在讲座、漫长的车程上学和汗流浃背的夏天之间，你不会期望有太大的改变……也就是说，直到你遇到库珀，一只在当地壳牌公司工作的鳄鱼（？）。

一开始只是简单地停下来加油，但可能会变成更多……

《Early Shift》是一部以佛罗里达州小镇为背景的毛茸茸视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://noisybear.itch.io/early-shift]Itch.io[/url]]
